Anant Singh Daughter Marriage: anant sinh ki beti shivangi ki shadi men aane vale mehmanon ke lie do alag-alag jaghon par 10 ekar men bhoj ki vyavastha ki gaee hai...karib 50 karigron ki 20 timen 10 lakh logon ke lie khana taiyar karne men jutengi.
Dekhie itne bare shahi bhoj ki taiyari aur rasoee ka pura intjam...
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
